# Test cards for the engine test suite. One exact Scryfall card name per line.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Multi-faced cards use the full "A // B" name.
#
# After editing: npm run cards -- fixtures
# That rewrites cards.json (Oracle rules fields only, sorted by name). The generator fails on
# any name that is not an exact Scryfall card name. Any other *.txt list in this folder is read too.
